key.description: The key used to route to this shard

partition_index.description: Which partition this shard belongs to

mechanism: The fundamental primitive of distribution. It deterministically partitions a Resource, {{state}}, or {{vector}} into disjoint subsets (Shards) based on a Key (e.g., ID, Hash, Time). Unlike `Decompose` (which splits complexity), `Shard` splits volume/load.
invariants: Determinism: Key K always routes to Shard S.

parameters.name: key_function
parameters.description: Partitioning strategy for distributing data across shards

parameters.name: partitions
parameters.description: Number of partitions to divide state into
